title: Fastned - Hyundai Ioniq Electric 30,5 kWh (2016-2019) charge graph
notes: Charge graph embedded in the Fastned vehicle page (Ioniq 30,5 kWh (2016 - 2019), charger class 150+), one kW value per SoC %, read with curl. Page carries no reuse terms and the Fastned terms of use have no clause on vehicle chart data (owner confirms). Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C.
